enchantmentdisabler.config.maxLevel.glob: Set this above 0 to change the max level for all enchantments all once. This will not override the levels defined in the Max levels list.
enchantmentdisabler.config.trades.limitB: Limit max enchanted book trade level
enchantmentdisabler.config.trades.modify: Limit max enchanted book trade uses
Set the maximum amount of times enchanted book trades can be used before having to restock. Vanilla is 12.
Limit max enchanted item trade uses
Set the maximum amount of times enchanted item trades can be used before having to restock. Vanilla is 3.
enchantmentdisabler.config.trades.enchan: Set to false to make enchanted book trades never restock.
Set to false to make enchanted item trades never restock.
enchantmentdisabler.config.enchantingTab: Set to false to completely disable the function of the enchanting table. Using it will do nothing. You'll still be able to get the Enchanter advancement by enchanting any item in the anvil.
Change the maximum amount of bookshelves that the enchanting table can accept to increase its enchanting power. Vanilla is 15.

Change the amount of lapis required to enchant items, where 'i' is the index of the given enchantment option:
i = 0 -> option 1
i = 1 -> option 2
i = 2 -> option 3
. Vanilla formula is 'id+1'

Change the amount of XP levels required to enchant items, where 'i' is the index of the given enchantment option:
i = 0 -> option 1
i = 1 -> option 2
i = 2 -> option 3
. Vanilla formula is 'id+1'
enchantmentdisabler.config.loot.modifyEn: Set a limit on how strong enchantments can be on looted equipment. For reference, the enchanting table has a limit of 30, and vanilla looted equipment limit can go up to 50 in some places.
